cases.question: How many customers are in the demo?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers

cases.question: How many completed orders are there?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status='completed'

cases.question: What are total gross sales in cents?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(gross_sales_cents) AS gross_sales_cents FROM sales_facts

cases.question: What is total net revenue in cents?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents FROM sales_facts

cases.question: What is the total refunded amount in cents?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_cents) AS refund_cents FROM refunds

cases.question: How many units were sold on completed orders?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS units FROM sales_facts WHERE status='completed'

cases.question: Show net revenue in cents by calendar month, oldest first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT month, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents FROM sales_facts GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

cases.question: Show gross sales in cents by category, alphabetically.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT category, SUM(gross_sales_cents) AS gross_sales_cents FROM sales_facts GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

cases.question: Show net revenue in cents by region, including unknown regions.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(region,'Unknown') AS region, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents FROM sales_facts GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

cases.question: Show completed order counts per customer name, sorted by name.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name,COUNT(o.order_id) AS completed_orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id,c.customer_name ORDER BY c.customer_name

cases.question: Show units sold per product on completed orders, sorted by product name.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name,SUM(i.quantity) AS units FROM products p JOIN order_items i ON p.product_id=i.product_id JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.product_id,p.product_name ORDER BY p.product_name

cases.question: Which customers have no orders?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.customer_name

cases.question: Which products have never been ordered?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items i ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.item_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.product_name

cases.question: What is the average completed-order gross value in cents, rounded to two decimals?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(gross),2) AS average_order_gross_cents FROM (SELECT o.order_id,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents) AS gross FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY o.order_id) x

cases.question: What is the average unit count per completed order, rounded to two decimals?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(units),2) AS units_per_order FROM (SELECT o.order_id,SUM(i.quantity) AS units FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY o.order_id) x

cases.question: Show monthly category net revenue target attainment as a ratio rounded to four decimals.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT a.month,a.category,ROUND(a.net*1.0/t.target_cents,4) AS attainment FROM (SELECT month,category,SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net FROM sales_facts GROUP BY month,category) a JOIN targets t ON a.month=t.month AND a.category=t.category ORDER BY a.month,a.category

cases.question: Who are the top three customers by net revenue in cents, with customer name as the tie breaker?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name,SUM(f.net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents FROM customers c JOIN sales_facts f ON c.customer_id=f.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id,c.customer_name ORDER BY net_revenue_cents DESC,c.customer_name LIMIT 3

cases.question: How many distinct order items received refunds?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT item_id) AS refunded_items FROM refunds

cases.question: How many refund events are recorded?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS refund_events FROM refunds

cases.question: What is the largest total refund for one item in cents?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(amount) AS maximum_item_refund_cents FROM (SELECT item_id,SUM(amount_cents) AS amount FROM refunds GROUP BY item_id) r

cases.question: How many orders were cancelled?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status='cancelled'

cases.question: What gross sales do cancelled items contribute in cents?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(gross_sales_cents) AS gross_sales_cents FROM sales_facts WHERE status='cancelled'

cases.question: What is April 2026 net revenue in cents for the North region?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents FROM sales_facts WHERE order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND order_date < '2026-05-01' AND region='North'

cases.question: What are March 2026 gross sales in cents for Hardware?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(gross_sales_cents) AS gross_sales_cents FROM sales_facts WHERE order_date >= '2026-03-01' AND order_date < '2026-04-01' AND category='Hardware'

cases.question: How many completed orders were placed in April 2026?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS completed_orders FROM sales_facts WHERE status='completed' AND order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND order_date < '2026-05-01'

cases.question: How many distinct product categories exist?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category) AS categories FROM products

cases.question: What net revenue in cents belongs to customers whose region is unknown?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents FROM sales_facts WHERE region IS NULL

cases.question: Show refund cents by product category without multiplying refund events.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT category, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents FROM sales_facts WHERE refund_cents > 0 GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

cases.question: Show January 2026 daily net revenue in cents in date order.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_date,SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents FROM sales_facts WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-02-01' GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date

cases.question: What is the March-to-April 2026 net revenue growth ratio, rounded to four decimals?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((cur.net-prev.net)*1.0/NULLIF(prev.net,0),4) AS growth_ratio FROM (SELECT SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net FROM sales_facts WHERE order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND order_date < '2026-05-01') cur CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net FROM sales_facts WHERE order_date >= '2026-03-01' AND order_date < '2026-04-01') prev
